blocks.text: A Conductor Mast reserves four blocks of height when placed. Upper sections belong to one controller; breaking an extension removes that structure and should return one controller, not four independent machines.

options.legend: C controller/base; M reserved mast section. This is a side view, not a floor plan.

blocks.text: Weather Stations link to the nearest mast on the same height level within their configured search range. The shipped range is ten blocks. Transmitters within the shipped twenty-block range shorten the strike interval and can increase generation. Right-click a Weather Station to inspect its link.
Generation occurs in bursts, not a perfectly constant FE/t source. Leave buffer space and sufficient cable throughput before concluding that a paused burst is a failure.
